title: 第14章 我有一个点子
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

现在向你走来的是，黑袍传奇抗压王——艾！什！莉！

已来到超级七人队的大会议室参观的莱恩在心中狂呼不止。

赵子龙浑身是胆，艾什莉浑身都是赵子龙。

作为一个啥能力都没有的普通人，这姐儿能在祖宝身边一直活着简直就是一个奇迹。

你瞅瞅这姐儿的职场环境。

阴晴不定的杀人魔巨婴老板，在外面惹了一屁股人命官司的同事，被渗透的像筛子似的公司，辞职就可能被灭口的职业。

人家是常在河边走哪能不湿鞋，艾什莉直接对祖宝说：我可以下去游一圈。

只要你说，光腚子仰泳都行，忠诚！

“祖国人！”

急匆匆跑进会议室的艾什莉满心满眼都是阿祖，慌里慌张又强作镇定的她一进来就嚷嚷着：“紧急事态！先生。”

“天呐，你看到了吗？”

“油管昨晚上传的视频，十七分钟后网络安全部门就已经将它全面下架了，但……”

“艾什莉！”

阿祖忽然出声制止了她接下来的话。

理由同刚才风暴闯进他房间被他撵走一样，他绝不想将自己误杀平民的事情给儿子知道。

小家伙那么信任他，为此甚至都与他相依为命的母亲闹翻了，这要是让莱恩知道这件事，他得对自己多么失望。

一想到这里，阿祖的心情也开始紧张起来。

不行，得想个办法让莱恩暂时远离网络，不能让外面那些乱七八糟的信息误导他。

可是这该怎么说呢？

昨晚才接回莱恩，今天就给他送走？

问题是祖宝自己也不舍得啊……

“咚——”

就在阿祖分神琢磨办法的一瞬间，本就很紧张的艾什莉被他一声喝止，手一瓢直接按下了播放键。

作为英雄管理高级副总裁，艾什莉·巴雷特随身携带的平板是能够自动连接公司网络的，早在她匆匆赶回来以后，她的平板画面就已经同步到了这间大会议室。

而她的平板为何会随时准备播放事件画面，为的就是让很可能不知情的祖国人第一时间了解事态。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

Coming towards you now is the legendary pressure-resistant king in black robe - Ai!Varied!Li!

Ryan, who had come to visit the Super Seven's large conference room, was screaming in his heart.

Zhao Zilong is full of courage, and Ashley is full of Zhao Zilong.

As an ordinary person with no abilities, it is a miracle that this sister can stay alive by Zu Bao's side.

Take a look at this girl's workplace situation.

The unstable murderous giant baby boss, the colleague who caused a life-threatening lawsuit outside, the company that was penetrated like a sieve, and the profession where you could be silenced if you resign.

People often walk by the river without getting their shoes wet. Ashley said directly to Zu Bao: I can go for a swim.

As long as you say it, you can swim on your back with just your buttocks, loyalty!

"People of the motherland!"

Ashley hurried into the conference room with Azu in her mind and eyes. She was panicking but trying to stay calm as soon as she entered: "Emergency! Sir."

"Oh my God, did you see that?"

"The video uploaded by YouTube last night was completely removed by the network security department after seventeen minutes, but..."

"Ashley!"

Azu suddenly stopped her next words.

The reason was the same as when Feng Feng broke into his room and was kicked out by him just now. He never wanted to let his son know about his accidental killing of civilians.

The little guy trusted him so much that he even had a falling out with his mother, whom he depended on for life. If Ryan knew about this, he would be so disappointed in himself.

Thinking of this, Azu began to feel nervous.

No, we have to find a way to keep Ryan away from the Internet for a while, and we can't let the messy information outside mislead him.

But what should I say?

You just picked up Ryan last night and are sending him away today?

The problem is that Zu Bao himself is not willing to part with it...

"Dong——"

At the moment when Azu was distracted and thinking about a solution, Ashley, who was already very nervous, was stopped by him and pressed the play button with a scoop of his hand.

As the senior vice president of Hero Management, the tablet that Ashley Barrett carries with her can automatically connect to the company network. After she hurried back, her tablet screen had been synchronized to the large conference room.

And why her tablet is ready to play footage of the incident at any time, so that the people of the motherland who may not be aware of it can understand the situation as soon as possible.
